latestVersion.changelog:
AI-powered wedding invitation video creation tool — easily make, edit, and export personalized video invites.

- Upload photos and text to generate wedding invitation videos with AI — no manual editing.
- Supports image (JPG, PNG, HEIC) and video (MP4) uploads up to 200MB; export high-quality 1080p MP4.
- Automatic onboarding: gets you a temporary token and session on first use, no registration needed.
- Clear workflows for uploading, editing, exporting, and checking balance or status.
- Friendly error handling with user guidance for common issues (credits, file types, export limits).
- Built for engaged couples and wedding planners needing fast, shareable invitations.
